admission.scope: selection without execution or numerical reservation

decision.selected_method: native complete physical acceptance plus non-equivalent same-structure robustness validation

original_plan.expected_observation: Native selection should retain H29 as the best accepted execution while recognizing H30 as independent complete robustness evidence on the identical structure.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen T09 task, seed 17, original 2.0 s horizon, unchanged evaluator and hard checks, common candidate 011e35d4657d2a85f55654f8b14a91b20c2178e1242038820e0c474da16c6886.
original_plan.hypothesis: The H29 common physical structure with axis-decoupled tendon routing, anisotropic stiff sections, centered constant hold, and a slow 0.72 N near-touch release is the strongest accepted design; H30's 10 ms release-endpoint perturbation independently confirms that acceptance is not confined to one exact schedule.
original_plan.interpretation: H29 and H30 both pass all original hard checks. H30 perturbs the release endpoint from 1.70 s to 1.69 s and therefore independently tests local timing robustness. Exact identical replay was not launched because Core required an absent explicit replication grant.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Select only because H29 and H30 both have complete accepted physical evidence on the same structure; do not infer broader guarantees.
original_plan.weakening_observation: Selection would be weakened if either H29 or H30 failed any original hard check, used a different physical structure, or lacked complete physical evaluation.
